purpose: Form FC-1 is used by a foreign company to deliver a list of directors and Secretary, along with required documents and particulars, to the Registrar upon establishing a place of business in India.
when: Within thirty days of establishment of its place of business in India.
steps: Establish a place of business in India.
Prepare Form FC-1 containing the required particulars of directors and Secretary.
Gather the documents required under section 380(1) and the RBI or other regulator approvals or declaration.
Deliver Form FC-1 with the required fee to the Registrar, Central Registration Centre.
Deliver the documents to the Registrar having jurisdiction over New Delhi.
checklist: Personal name and surname in full for each director and Secretary
Any former name or names and surname or surnames in full
Father's name, mother's name, or spouse's name
Date of birth and residential address
Passport details including number, date of issue, and country of issue
Income-tax permanent account number (PAN), if applicable
Directorship details in other Indian companies and other directorships
Membership Number for the Secretary only
attachments: Documents required to be delivered for registration by a foreign company under section 380(1)
Attested copy of approval from the Reserve Bank of India under Foreign Exchange Management Act or Regulations
Attested copy of approval from other regulators, if required
Declaration from the authorised representative that no such approval is required
watch: Documents for registration must be delivered to the Registrar, Central Registration Centre, and to the Registrar having jurisdiction over New Delhi.
